# project-tree-md — Complete Technical Specification & LLM Reference Manual

> Deep Technical Documentation for AI Assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, DeepSeek) and Automated Code Analysis Pipelines.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Core Value Proposition

`project-tree-md` is an enterprise-grade, zero-dependency Node.js CLI tool and programmatic library that converts any codebase into structured, visual, and AI-optimized representations:
1. **Interactive 2D Canvas & 3D WebGL Code Relationship Graphs** (`CODE_GRAPH.html`, `CODE_GRAPH_3D.html`)
2. **Interactive Horizontal Node Mind Maps** (`PROJECT_MINDMAP.html`)
3. **Structured Markdown Directory Trees** (`PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md`)
4. **Machine-Readable Exports**: JSON (`PROJECT_STRUCTURE.json`), SVG (`PROJECT_STRUCTURE.svg`), Mermaid.js (`PROJECT_STRUCTURE.mmd`)
5. **Standalone ZIP Package Bundles** (`project-analysis.zip`)
6. **Architecture Execution & Data Flow Models** (`ARCHITECTURE_FLOW.html`)
7. **AI & LLM Grounding Context** (`AI_CONTEXT.md`, `AI_PROMPT.md`, `AGENTS.md`)

---

## 2. Technical Architecture & Constraints

- **Language & Runtime**: Node.js CommonJS (Node.js 20+)
- **Dependency Philosophy**: Strict **Zero External Dependencies** (`dependencies: {}`). Uses exclusively Node.js core modules:
  - `fs`: File system traversal, synchronous stat/read/write, stream management.
  - `path`: Cross-platform normalized POSIX/Windows path resolution.
  - `crypto`: High-performance cryptographic hashing (MD5, SHA1, SHA256) for duplicate file detection.
  - `child_process`: Git CLI integration for changed/modified/untracked status detection.
  - `http`: Embedded zero-dependency live reload server with Server-Sent Events (SSE).
  - `os`: CPU and memory diagnostic telemetry.
- **Safety**: Safe handling of circular symlinks, deep nested node_modules, binary asset detection, and file descriptor limits.

---

## 3. Command-Line Interface (CLI) Specification

### Primary Binaries:
- `project-tree-md`
- `ptree`
- `tree-md`

### Complete Command Flag Reference:

| Flag / Option | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--visualize` | `graph`, `code-graph` | boolean | `false` | Generates 2D Canvas & 3D WebGL Code Relationship Graph HTML (`CODE_GRAPH.html`) and auto-opens in default browser. |
| `--mindmap` | `roadmap`, `codemap` | boolean | `false` | Generates interactive horizontal Bezier mind map HTML (`PROJECT_MINDMAP.html`). |
| `--flow` | `--architecture` | boolean | `false` | Analyzes framework roles and generates entry-to-leaf execution flow HTML (`ARCHITECTURE_FLOW.html`). |
| `--ai` | `--format=ai` | boolean | `false` | Generates token-optimized AI Context document (`AI_CONTEXT.md`) for LLM prompting. |
| `--prompt` | — | boolean | `false` | Generates ready-to-paste system prompt snippet (`AI_PROMPT.md`). |
| `--ai-rules` | — | boolean | `false` | Generates repo-tailored AI agent rules (`AGENTS.md`). |
| `--tokens` | — | boolean | `false` | Estimates token count and API cost (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5). |
| `--bundle` | `--zip` | string/bool | `false` | Compiles analysis reports into a standalone ZIP package (`project-analysis.zip`). |
| `--json` | — | boolean | `false` | Exports hierarchy as JSON (`PROJECT_STRUCTURE.json`). |
| `--svg` | — | boolean | `false` | Exports vector diagram (`PROJECT_STRUCTURE.svg`). |
| `--mermaid` | — | boolean | `false` | Exports Mermaid diagram (`PROJECT_STRUCTURE.mmd`). |
| `--details` | `-d` | boolean | `false` | Shows file byte size, line count, and extension info inline. |
| `--git-status` | — | boolean | `false` | Appends Git status badges (`[Modified]`, `[Added]`, `[Untracked]`). |
| `--changed-only`| — | boolean | `false` | Filters directory tree to include only Git changed/untracked files (`CHANGED_FILES_TREE.md`). |
| `--duplicates` | — | boolean | `false` | Finds duplicate files across the repository (`PROJECT_DUPLICATES.md`). |
| `--sort` | — | string | `null` | Sorts entries: `alpha`, `folders-first`, `files-first`, `size`, `modified`, `created`. |
| `--theme` | — | string | `unicode` | Tree connector styling: `unicode`, `ascii`, `emoji`, `box`, `rounded`, `double`, `minimal`. |
| `--depth` | `-L` | number | `unlimited`| Maximum folder traversal depth. |
| `--exclude` | `-I` | regex | `default` | Custom exclusion regex pattern. |
| `--serve` | — | boolean | `false` | Starts local zero-dependency HTTP server with live reload SSE on port 3000 (or `--port <n>`). |
| `--silent` | — | boolean | `true` | Suppresses raw stdout tree to avoid terminal clutter (use `--verbose` or `--no-silent` to print). |
| `--open-html` | `--no-open` | boolean | `true` | Auto-opens generated HTML visualizations in the default web browser. |

---

## 4. Programmatic API Reference

All core functions are accessible via standard CommonJS import:

```javascript
const {
  generateTree,
  scan,
  computeStats,
  generateUniversalGraph,
  toHtml,
  toMindmapHtml,
  toGraphVisualizerHtml,
  toGraph3dVisualizerHtml,
  generateAiContext,
  generateAiPrompt,
  generateAiRules,
  generateBundle,
  getGitStatus,
  loadConfig
} = require('project-tree-md');
```

### 4.1 `generateTree(options)`
Generates complete structured tree text, Markdown output, and parsed statistics.

```javascript
const result = generateTree({
  rootDir: process.cwd(),
  outputFile: 'PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md',
  theme: 'emoji',          // 'unicode' | 'ascii' | 'emoji' | 'box' | 'rounded'
  details: true,           // Show file sizes and line counts
  gitStatus: true,         // Show Git status badges
  changedOnly: false,      // Filter only changed files
  maxDepth: 5,             // Traversal depth limit
  writeFile: true          // Write to disk (default true)
});

console.log(result.markdown);       // Formatted GitHub-ready Markdown string
console.log(result.treeText);       // Raw tree text block
console.log(result.stats);          // File counts, directory counts, size stats
console.log(result.outputPath);     // Absolute path to written output file
```

### 4.2 `generateUniversalGraph(rootDir, tree)`
Extracts full language-agnostic module relationships, dependency trees, imports, exports, routes, and controllers into a unified graph data model.

```javascript
const graphModel = generateUniversalGraph(process.cwd());

console.log(graphModel.nodes.length); // Total files & components
console.log(graphModel.edges.length); // Total import/export relationships
```

### 4.3 `generateBundle(options)`
Assembles all visual reports, JSON data models, and Markdown files into a pure JavaScript ZIP buffer.

```javascript
const bundle = generateBundle({
  rootDir: process.cwd(),
  outputDir: process.cwd(),
  bundleName: 'project-analysis.zip',
  exportList: 'html,json,svg,mindmap,graph'
});

console.log(bundle.summaryText);
```

---

## 5. Supported Languages & Framework Detection

`project-tree-md` includes built-in heuristic and AST-like regular expression scanners for:
- **JavaScript & TypeScript**: React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Angular, Svelte, Express, NestJS, Node.js, Fastify.
- **Python**: Django, Flask, FastAPI, PyTorch, Pandas, Poetry, Pipenv.
- **Mobile**: Flutter, React Native, Dart, Android (Gradle/Kotlin), iOS (Swift/Xcode).
- **Backend & Systems**: Go (Gin/Fiber), Rust (Cargo/Actix), Java (Spring Boot/Maven/Gradle), C# (.NET/ASP.NET), PHP (Laravel/Symfony), Ruby (Rails), C/C++ (CMake/Makefile).

---

## 6. Output File Strategy (No Overwriting)

Every CLI command targets an isolated, task-specific file to guarantee non-destructive execution:
- Default tree ➔ `PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md`
- `--git-status` ➔ `GIT_STATUS_TREE.md`
- `--changed-only` ➔ `CHANGED_FILES_TREE.md`
- `--sort` ➔ `SORTED_TREE.md`
- `--duplicates` ➔ `PROJECT_DUPLICATES.md`
- `--modified / --permissions` ➔ `FILE_ATTRIBUTES.md`
- `--exclude / -I` ➔ `FILTERED_TREE.md`
- `--depth / -L` ➔ `DEPTH_TREE.md`
- `--max-files / --bfs` ➔ `LIMITED_TREE.md`
- `--theme / --icons` ➔ `THEMED_TREE.md`
- `--details` ➔ `FORMATTED_TREE.md`
- `--ai / --format=ai` ➔ `AI_CONTEXT.md`
- `--prompt` ➔ `AI_PROMPT.md`
- `--ai-rules` ➔ `AGENTS.md`
- `--visualize` ➔ `CODE_GRAPH.html`
- `--mindmap` ➔ `PROJECT_MINDMAP.html`
- `--flow` ➔ `ARCHITECTURE_FLOW.html`
- `--bundle` ➔ `project-analysis.zip`

---

## 7. Performance & Benchmark Summary

| Metric | project-tree-md | Standard OS tree | tree-cli (npm) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dependencies** | **0 (Pure Node.js)** | OS-dependent | 10+ dependencies |
| **Scan Speed (10k files)**| **~450ms** | ~600ms | ~1,800ms |
| **2D/3D WebGL Graph** | **Yes (Built-in)** | No | No |
| **Interactive Mind Map** | **Yes (Built-in)** | No | No |
| **Git Status Badges** | **Yes (`[Modified]`, etc.)** | No | No |
| **AI LLM Optimization** | **Yes (Token-optimized)** | No | No |
| **ZIP Package Bundler** | **Yes (Pure JS CRC32)** | No | No |
| **Cross-Platform Support**| **Windows, macOS, Linux** | OS specific | Windows/Linux/macOS |
